about: The sea slugs' own ID marks, by genus and by family (study docs/reviews/2026-11-15-nudibranch-mode-study.md §9, step 7: family and genus sheets with sourced cues; Pierre, 2026-11-17: complete what is missing for the nudibranchs). Our own words, short and plain, never copied, written from public specialist sources: src, each {t, u}, t starting with the source's short name before its first comma (the quiz feedback's label names it). genera and families, by name: marks, 1 to 3 [visible feature that tells it from its family siblings and its look-alikes, its refs], a ref being [src key, where in it (a key couplet and page, or the species a fact sheet is about, by its name today)]. Only features seen on a photo from above or from the side, or the animal on its food: never a count, nor a feature seen only under the animal or in the hand; a species named is one of the genus's game species (rule C6). none: a genus left without marks and why (no photo feature in the sources read): never a mark guessed. apart: the declared genus pairs' tell-apart lines (Pierre, 2026-11-18, the feedback sheet study's question (d); docs/decisions/2026-11-18-tellapart-lines.md), {"A|B": {A: line, B: line}}, each side describing its own genus with its refs, one side only when no source read gives the other's; apartNone: the declared pairs left without a line, and why. tools/seaslug_cues.py checks them and puts marks, msrc and mby on seaslug.json's genera and families (tools/seaslug_game.py); app.js fishGenera shows a genus's marks in the quiz feedback, learn.js genMarks and fishMarks on the sheets. Sources consulted: docs/reviews/2026-11-18-seaslug-cues-sources.md.

apartNone.Tambja|Tyrannodoris: the one comparison read (Nudi Pixel, Willan: the Tambja affinis group) sets Tyrannodoris luteolineata (very large oral tentacles, two plain head stripes) apart from Tambja affinis and T. victoriae, not from the game's Tambja (T. morosa, T. olivaria)
apartNone.Chelidonura|Tubulophilinopsis: the one comparison read (Nudi Pixel, Kodiat: Chelidonura varians against Tubulophilinopsis gardineri) sets the two species apart by their tail lobes; no source read says it of either genus
apartNone.Hypselodoris|Thorunna: the sources read compare Hypselodoris maculosa with Thorunna australis, which is not a game species; no feature of the genus Thorunna was found

none.Ardeadoris: Johnson and Gosliner 2012 define it by its DNA alone; SEASLUG.WORLD's Ardeadoris egretta page and the Sea Slug Forum's sheet give a white body with a yellow rim, a pattern other genera share (SEASLUG.WORLD: it differs inside); Rudman 1984's diagnosis not read
none.Caloria: the Sea Slug Forum's Caloria indica sheet (as Phidiana indica) says its genus cannot be settled; no source read gives a feature of the genus
none.Taringa: its one game species, T. halgerda, looks like a Halgerda: the Sea Slug Forum's and SEASLUG.WORLD's pages say only its anatomy places it in Taringa; no external feature of the genus was found
none.Verconia: Johnson and Gosliner 2012 place its species by DNA; the game's V. alboannulata and V. norba share the pink, white-rimmed pattern of Rudman's Noumea purpurea colour group, which the Sea Slug Forum shows across several genera
